name: patient_is_healthy_adult_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently a healthy adult.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently considered a healthy adult.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not considered a healthy adult.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently a healthy adult.

name: patient_has_finding_of_allergy_to_latex_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has an allergy to latex.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has an allergy to latex.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have an allergy to latex.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has an allergy to latex.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_illness_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has any illness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any illness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have any illness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has any illness.
